steps.step: AC-001-01: Given valid user_id credentials and email When the registration endpoint is called Then the user is persisted with salted password hash and status PROCESSED
AC-001-02: Given a duplicate user_id or non-positive quantity When the registration endpoint is called Then a 422 DomainError is raised
AC-002-01: Given verified user_id credentials When the login endpoint is called Then a signed session token is returned with status PROCESSED
AC-003-01: Given an authenticated session When credential update is submitted Then password hash is rotated and persisted with status PROCESSED
